title: Knitting
content: Anqi enjoys knitting and sees it as a slow, hands-on creative practice that helps her unwind through texture, color, and patience.

title: Tennis
content: She likes tennis for its rhythm and the balance between focus, movement, and repetition that makes every match feel a little different.

title: Guinea pigs
content: Anqi has a soft spot for guinea pigs and sees them as a source of personality, chaos, and joy in everyday life. Anqi has 4 guinea pigs. They're Yoyo, Dabao, Xiaohei, and Tutu.
